holes.name: HassePrincipleRandomFano.theorem_1_1
holes.body:
/--
Statement of Theorem 1.1:

Let `d ≥ 2` and `n ≥ d` with `(d, n) ≠ (3, 3)`. Then we have `lim_{A → ∞} ρ_{d,n}(A) = ρˡᵒᶜ_{d,n}`.
-/
theorem theorem_1_1 (hd : 2 ≤ d) (h₁ : d ≤ n) (h₂ : (d, n) ≠ (3, 3)) :
    Tendsto (ρ d n) atTop (nhds (ρLoc d n)) := by
  sorry
